heading: Terms & Conditions
introduction: These Terms and Conditions are between {consultant}, hereinafter called the Consultant, and {company_name}, hereinafter called the Client.
clauses: The fee will be charged at {percent}% of the candidate’s annual CTC (approximately {days} days’ salary), including basic salary and allowances. Applicable taxes, if any, will be charged extra.
Payment shall be made within 7 days of the candidate joining the Client’s organization, against the Consultant’s invoice.
If a candidate introduced by the Consultant is employed by the Client in any capacity within 12 months of the introduction, the Client shall pay the recruitment fee as per these terms.

The Client must not share candidate information outside the company without the consent of both the Consultant and the candidate. If an approved introduction results in employment with another company, the respective party shall pay the introduction fee.

If a candidate resigns voluntarily within the first 3 months of employment, the Consultant will provide a free replacement, provided the Client informs the Consultant in writing within 7 days of termination.
The Consultant is not responsible for any cash-related risk or transaction between the employee and employer.
These terms are subject to Indore jurisdiction.
The Client must follow applicable labour laws and other applicable laws.
Candidate salaries shall be as per prevailing industry norms and current market conditions.

The Client shall inform the Consultant within 5 working days of the candidate accepting the offer and provide the offer terms in writing, including the engagement or appointment letter and a copy of the employment contract.
